bio_md:
# 辽穆宗耶律璟 · 主要事迹

耶律璟（931—969），[[liao-tai-zong|太宗]]之子。天禄五年（951）[[liao-shi-zong|世宗]]被弑后即位，改元应历。

穆宗在位十九年，史称「嗜酒酣饮，不恤国事」：日晏不朝、昼夜宴饮，政事多废，人主失体。应历年间辽宋关系相持，北汉依辽抗周，边境小战不断。应历十九年（969）二月，近侍小哥等愤其暴虐，弑之于怀州行宫。

穆宗之政与[[liao-jing-zong|景宗]]形成对照——景宗即位后整饬纲纪、用萧绰预政，辽势复振，可见穆宗一朝之失。

bio_parts_en.value:
's assassination, era Yingli.

Muzong reigned nineteen years, remembered as "loving wine and long sleep, careless of state affairs": he missed court, drank day and night, and let government decay. During his reign Song-Liao relations held in equilibrium while Northern Han leaned on Liao against Zhou. In 969 his attendants, exasperated by his brutality, killed him at the Huaizhou palace.

His reign contrasts sharply with that of
, who restored order and shared power with Xiao Chuo - evidence of what Muzong's years had cost.
